scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:license: concurrently "npm run dev -w packages/license-server" "npm run dev -w packages/admin-portal"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/license-core && npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/frontend && npm run build -w packages/license-server && npm run build -w packages/admin-portal
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run prepare:backend -w packages/desktop-electron && npm run dist -w packages/desktop-electron
scripts.dist:desktop:win: npm run prepare:backend -w packages/desktop-electron && npm run dist:win -w packages/desktop-electron
scripts.dist:desktop:mac: npm run prepare:backend -w packages/desktop-electron && npm run dist:mac -w packages/desktop-electron
scripts.dist:desktop:linux: npm run prepare:backend -w packages/desktop-electron && npm run dist:linux -w packages/desktop-electron
scripts.db:generate: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:generate -w packages/backend
scripts.db:push: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:push -w packages/backend
scripts.db:studio: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:studio -w packages/backend
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:seed -w packages/backend
